reels.title: Coding-Agent Benchmarks Should Match Their Users' Task Flows

editorial_notes.reasoning: This addresses the high-velocity 'robotics_tamp' domain and provides a unique angle for developers by analyzing real-world IDE workflows, moving beyond synthetic benchmarks.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: Are your AI coding agents actually helpful, or are they just hallucinating in a vacuum?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: The difference between an apprentice reading a textbook and a seasoned pro navigating a messy, live construction site.
